schema:name: Reduced administrative costs for MOF/MOH.
schema:description:
This represents the lowering of operational expenditures within the Ministry of Finance or Ministry of Health through the automation of manual tasks. It focuses on optimizing the internal resources required to manage health financing cycles.

The goal is to maximize the percentage of the health budget that reaches frontline clinical services by minimizing bureaucratic overhead. It enhances fiscal efficiency by reducing the need for intensive manual intervention in routine financial processing.

Example: Consolidating multiple legacy payment systems into a single automated gateway to reduce staff time and licensing fees.
